shortDescription: The campaign here on Genoa is proceeding as planned. The Home Guards are doing what they can, but it will not be long until the world in fully under House Davion's control. Make another sweep and see what you turn up.
longDescription: Looks like we caught the easy ride this time, Commander.
missionSuccessStatementOverride: Good work, Commander, you made short work of your opponents.
badFaithStatementOverride: You managed to trip over and shoot yourself, Commander.
goodFaithStatementOverride: that was an unexpectedly poor performance.
